controls.title: Environment configuration is explicit and secret-safe
controls.description: Check production config boundaries and secret indirection.
checks: Check production config boundaries and secret indirection.
manual_questions: What concrete evidence supports: Environment configuration is explicit and secret-safe?
controls.pass_condition: An explicit environment template exists for a production/backend surface and no suspicious committed secret assignment is detected.
controls.partial_condition: Some environment/deployment configuration exists but the production boundary is incomplete.
controls.fail_condition: Potential secret-bearing environment configuration is committed, or no explicit environment/deployment configuration is present.
controls.not_applicable_condition: Applicability engine records NOT_APPLICABLE with an explicit reason.

controls.fail_condition: FAIL when applicable evidence contradicts "Health and readiness checks reflect real dependencies", the required capability is materially absent, or the check cannot be demonstrated after review: Differentiate process health from dependency readiness.
